name: code-trail-workspace
description: Code Trail 작업 공간. 배포하는 것은 packages/cli 의 code-trail 이다.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @code-trail/shared && npm run build -w @code-trail/server && npm run build:lib -w @code-trail/web && npm run build -w @code-trail/web && npm run build -w code-trail
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e/shell.e2e.mjs && node test/e2e/trail.e2e.mjs && node test/e2e/analysis.e2e.mjs && node test/e2e/share-html.e2e.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:pack && npm run test:install
